name: local-repovideo
description: Turn a folder on your machine into a short explainer video.
hookText: A folder on disk is enough.
tagline: A folder in. A short video out.

features.title: Local folder
features.desc: Nothing is fetched from a GitHub page

voiceover.hook: A public repo page is optional. A folder on your machine is enough.
voiceover.what: local-repovideo turns that folder into a short explainer. Cursor writes the script. This tool speaks it and renders the picture.
voiceover.features: Point it at a local folder. It writes a brief and does not upload it. Cursor fills in the scene lines. edge-tts speaks them, and Remotion renders 1080p. On Windows you can stay offline.
voiceover.tech: Python collects the brief and drives the render. Remotion draws the frames. edge-tts speaks. FFmpeg measures the audio.
voiceover.facts: No Gemini key. One folder. A 1080p video when it finishes.
voiceover.cta: Collect a brief, write the script, and render.
